brief.headline: SK Hynix crosses $1T cap, memory spot +90% Q1→Q2; HBM3E tight into H2 despite HBM4 ramp; hyperscaler $700B spend sustains CoWoS bottleneck
brief.summary: <cite index="41-3,41-4,46-1">SK Hynix surged 11% Wednesday to surpass $1 trillion market cap, extending YTD gains to ~250% on HBM3E supply to Nvidia and AI accelerator demand.</cite> <cite index="10-2,10-7,16-1">DRAM contract pricing jumped 90-95% QoQ in Q1 2026 and is forecast to rise another 58-63% in Q2, while NAND climbed 55-60% Q1 and will add 70-75% Q2, driven by HBM capacity reallocation and hyperscaler LTAs.</cite> <cite index="1-7,1-9,4-12">HBM3E remains ~66% of 2026 HBM shipments, with supply tight as Samsung and SK Hynix prioritize HBM4 ramp; both vendors negotiating ~20% HBM3E price hikes into 2026.</cite> <cite index="20-9,20-10,23-5">Hyperscalers disclosed ~$700B 2026 capex, nearly double 2025, with $25B+ memory-inflation drag cited by MSFT.</cite> <cite index="30-5,38-1">TSMC CoWoS capacity scales from 35k wpm late-2024 to 130k wpm by end-2026, still tight with Nvidia securing 60% allocation.</cite>
brief.pair_trade_view: <cite index="1-11,1-12">SK Hynix maintains 57-62% HBM market share through Q3 2025, securing first HBM3E supply for Google TPU v7 and targeting 70% HBM4 share for Nvidia Rubin in 2026.</cite> <cite index="5-2,5-5,5-6,5-7">Samsung's HBM4 passed Nvidia qualification with strong results, targeting February 2026 mass production at Pyeongtaek alongside SK Hynix's simultaneous ramp.</cite> <cite index="9-3,9-4">Samsung plans 47% HBM capacity boost to 250k wpm by end-2026 from current 170k, closing gap with SK Hynix's 160-170k baseline.</cite> Near-term edge to SK Hynix on HBM3E pricing power and Nvidia Blackwell allocation; Samsung catching up via HBM4 qualification wins (Google TPU, AMD MI450) and faster 10nm base-die vs. SK Hynix 12nm. Relative Samsung upside if HBM4 contracts finalize Q1 with better-than-expected allocations; SK Hynix downside if HBM3E→HBM4 transition accelerates faster than 55/45 revenue mix consensus. Pair spread vulnerable to memory-cycle peak-out narratives emerging Q3.

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="10-8,16-5">Q1 DRAM contract +90-95% QoQ marked record sequential increase; Q2 forecast +58-63% reflects slowing but elevated momentum.</cite> <cite index="14-5,14-6,14-7">Samsung and SK Hynix signaled no aggressive capacity expansion, prioritizing profitability; analysts project price rally extends past 2028.</cite> <cite index="11-4,11-5">Suppliers reallocating advanced nodes to server DRAM and HBM for AI, constraining general-purpose supply.</cite> <cite index="39-8,39-9,39-11">Investors debating whether industry shook off historical cyclicality; skeptics warn current prices assume prolonged discipline and high margins, vulnerable to crowding and shakeout.</cite> <cite index="44-13,44-23,44-24">Peak-out warnings emerging: IBK forecasts semiconductor export growth slowing from September; operating profit momentum may decelerate after Q3.</cite> Structural tailwinds (HBM 3:1 capacity ratio vs. DDR5, hyperscaler LTAs, AI inference SSD demand) support 2026-27 pricing, but valuation multiples (SK Hynix forward P/E 5.6x vs. historical 10x) reflect mean-reversion risk if capex slowdown or demand disappointment materializes H2.

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="1-7,1-9">HBM3E expected to account for ~66% of 2026 HBM shipments, with HBM4 gradually increasing share.</cite> <cite index="4-4,4-5,4-8,4-10">HBM3E demand exceeds expectations: Nvidia H200 China export approval added 40k-80k chips; Google TPU v7 integrates 8 HBM3E stacks, Amazon Trainium3 uses 4 stacks, both shipping 2026; HBM content/accelerator up 20-30% vs. prior gen.</cite> <cite index="4-12,4-13">Supply remains tight as Samsung/SK Hynix prioritize HBM4 ramp; analysts forecast 2026 HBM revenue mix ~55% HBM4 / 45% HBM3E, with HBM4 rapid absorption starting Q3.</cite> <cite index="2-11,2-15,2-16">Nvidia reportedly inquired about 16-layer HBM delivery Q4 2026, pulling forward generational transition before 12-layer HBM4 reaches full rollout; 16-layer may be classified HBM4E.</cite> <cite index="5-12,5-13,5-14">Samsung uses 10nm base die (vs. SK Hynix 12nm), achieving 11.7Gbps in internal tests.</cite> <cite index="9-7,9-8,9-9">Both vendors delivered paid final HBM4 samples to Nvidia; performance close to specs, negotiations in pre-contract phase; volumes/pricing to be set Q1 2026 with definitive outcome mid-to-late Q1.</cite> <cite index="5-16">HBM production capacities for both already sold out for next year.</cite> Watch Q1 contract announcements for Nvidia Rubin allocation split and pricing; any HBM4E acceleration timeline shifts; Samsung HBM3E qualification progress for H200/Blackwell.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix crosses $1 trillion market cap, joining Samsung and Micron
news_pulse.implication: All three global memory majors now above $1T valuation; sector concentration risk elevated with Samsung + SK Hynix >40% of KOSPI. Retail euphoria signal; single-stock leverage ETFs listing 5/27 adds volatility catalyst.

news_pulse.headline: Micron jumps 19%, hits $1T cap after UBS lifts PT to $1,625 on agentic AI demand
news_pulse.implication: UBS thesis: memory evolving from cyclical to structurally higher-margin business. Drives Samsung +6%, SK Hynix +8% in pre-market 5/27. Validates super-cycle narrative but raises peak-multiple risk.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM/NAND Q2 pricing revised up: DRAM +58-63%, NAND +70-75% QoQ
news_pulse.implication: Sequential momentum slowing from Q1's +90-95% DRAM spike but still extreme. NAND accelerating on enterprise SSD tightness. No capacity relief until late 2027; hyperscaler LTAs locking supply.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex hits ~$700B, up 77% YoY; memory inflation adds $25B to MSFT budget
news_pulse.implication: Meta raised guidance to $125-145B, MSFT ~$190B, Alphabet $180-190B, Amazon $200B. 60-75% of uplift funds AI infra. Samsung/SK Hynix cited as premium-pricing negotiators. Sustains HBM/DDR5 demand into 2027 but Meta -9% on spending rebellion.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix plan ~20% HBM3E price hike for 2026 contracts
news_pulse.implication: Unusual mid-product-cycle hike; HBM3E supply lagging demand as HBM4 ramp prioritized. H200 China approval, Google TPU v7, Amazon Trainium3 driving incremental stacks. Pricing power intact through H1.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS capacity to reach 120-130k wpm by end-2026, up from 75-80k late-2025; Nvidia secures 60%
news_pulse.implication: Global CoWoS demand forecast 1M wafers 2026; Nvidia books 595k (515k TSMC, 80k Amkor/ASE). Bottleneck easing but Nvidia anchor-tenant lock limits AMD/ASIC flexibility. TSMC outsourcing 240-270k wafers to Amkor/SPIL.

news_pulse.headline: Foreign investors dump ₩10.6T of Samsung/SK Hynix in one week (Nov 18-22, 2025 data)
news_pulse.implication: 73% of total foreign selling concentrated in semis; profit-taking after KOSPI 7,000 break. Rotation into robotics/ESS. Signals overheat; contrasts with today's +6-8% rally, suggesting tactical re-entry or momentum chase.

news_pulse.headline: Mirae Asset raises SK Hynix PT to ₩3.8M (+18.8%), Samsung to ₩550K (+14.6%); peak-out warnings for Q3
news_pulse.implication: Bulls cite forward P/B 3.0x vs. avg 6.2x, ROE rising to 66% 2026-28. Bears (IBK, Shinhan, LS) flag export growth deceleration from September, OP momentum peak Q2-Q3. KOSPI 10,000 debate live.

brief.derivatives_signal: <cite index="45-1,45-3,45-4">16 single-stock 2X leverage/inverse ETFs tracking Samsung and SK Hynix list 5/27; products amplify volatility on earnings, cycle shifts, and AI investment sentiment.</cite> <cite index="45-9,45-10">Regulators warned of concentration risk and short-term fund flows tied to specific news/earnings dates.</cite> <cite index="42-25,42-27">Listing expected to inject temporary volatility into KOSPI session.</cite> Tactical implication: 2X products magnify intraday swings; watch for gamma-like pin risk around earnings (Samsung Q2 prelim early July, SK Hynix late July) and any HBM contract headlines. Elevated IV likely; consider selling OTM calls into retail euphoria if realized vol lags implied. ADR (SSNLF, HXSCL) spreads vs. KRX may widen on local leverage-product flows.
watch_for_next_3h: Samsung or SK Hynix HBM4 contract announcement / Nvidia Rubin allocation split headlines (Mirae forecasts Samsung OP ₩371T 2026, SK Hynix ₩290T; any Nvidia design-win leak moves stocks 5%+)
KOSPI response to single-stock leverage ETF debut (9:00 KST open 5/28); monitor for momentum exhaustion vs. retail inflow continuation
Q2 DRAM/NAND spot pricing data from DRAMeXchange; any downward revision to TrendForce +58-63% DRAM / +70-75% NAND Q2 forecast = early peak-out signal
Hyperscaler (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN) June-quarter capex color from investor events; memory procurement commentary post-$700B guide; any pushback on 2H spend = demand-side risk
